column1: # What each C11 unit of wz's SCE sources costs a Cortex-M4 object, in bytes, and how far
# each figure may drift (Layer Bc, scripts/c11-lane.sh, step 4).
# Columns: unit, .text, .rodata, .data, .bss of the object the unit's header compiles to
# alone with SCE ADR 0110 D3's flags and every inline function kept: the unit and what
# it includes (the codecs it imports and the header-only runtime), so a figure is what
# the unit can cost an image that uses all of it, not what one image pays.
# Every figure is MEASURED by `bash scripts/c11-lane.sh --record`, with the compiler
# named on the measured-with line, never estimated. A figure moves only by a commit
# that re-records it and says what the bytes bought; the lane fails on a figure outside

# The band is the one SCE's own C11 budget uses (vendor/sce/backends/c/mcu/footprint.budget):
